name: agent-pulse
description: A box above the prompt that always says what the agent is doing right now, alive with color and motion: an animated status glyph, a glowing jellyfish on the desktop, a timeline of the turn, and a history behind its triangle. Fork of Tzafrir Rehan's whats-agent-doing 0.4.3.

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: How much the box moves: off (still), subtle (spinning status glyph, flashes, a swimming jellyfish on the desktop) or full (adds the shimmer, the breathing border while it waits on you, bubbles, ink and sparkles)

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: claude follows your theme with the Claude orange; neon is vivid; mono keeps color for what needs you

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: approval plays a soft chime when Claude starts waiting for your approval
